---
title: "Write the main finding as a sentence"
subtitle: "Optional: what, in whom, measured how"
shorttitle: "Short title for the running head"
author:
  - "Author Name"
  - "Institute"
institute: "Institute"
venue:
  - "Journal or meeting"
  - "Draft"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
keywords: "three to five keywords"
abstract: |
  One paragraph: question, design, main result with its uncertainty, conclusion.
documentclass: bleisatz
# Without options: Bleisatz 1-bit, light, IBM Plex, progress bar, A4.
# Uncomment a line to change one thing; values in brackets are the defaults.
classoption:
  # - dark              # [light] white on black, for reading on screen
  # - progress=dots     # [bar] | dots | none
  # - font=mono         # [plex] | mono | c64 (LuaLaTeX) | etbb (ET Book)
  # - total             # folio "3 / 8"
  # - nohead            # no running head
  # - justified         # [ragged right]
  # - letterpaper       # [a4paper]
  # --- Tufte, aspect by aspect -------------------------------------------
  # - layout=tufte      # [bleisatz] | tufte (110 mm column, 52 mm margin)
  # - notes=side        # [foot] | side (numbered sidenotes)
  # - palette=grey      # [onebit] | grey (one grey) | tufte (grey, red, green)
  # - rules=hair        # [heavy] | hair
  # - typography=tufte  # [bleisatz] | tufte (italic, unnumbered headings)
  # - emphasis=italic   # [inverse] | italic (no reversed type)
  # - figures=tufte     # [bleisatz] | tufte (Tufte figure folders first)
  # - tufte             # all Tufte aspects at once; lines above switch single ones back
header-includes:
  - \figurefolder{figures}
# References: uncomment, and cite with [@key]; biber runs with latexmk.
# bibliography: references.bib
output:
  rmarkdown::pdf_document:
    template: bleisatz-document.latex
    dev: cairo_pdf
    # citation_package: biblatex
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# The class file goes next to this document; figures are saved at the size
# of the slots (full 134 mm, side 86 mm, half 64 mm) and placed with the
# class's own commands.
library(ggplot2)
library(infereportR)
file.copy(deck_theme_file("class"), ".", overwrite = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, fig.show = "hide")
inch <- function(preset) unlist(figure_size(preset)[c("width", "height")]) / 25.4
side <- inch("slide_side")
full <- inch("slide_full")
plot_paper <- ggplot(PlantGrowth, aes(group, weight)) +
  geom_point(shape = 1) +
  theme_figure("slide") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Dried weight (g)")
```

# Introduction

Each section heading names what the section shows.

```{r side, fig.width = side[[1]], fig.height = side[[2]]}
plot_paper
```

\sidefigure{`r knitr::fig_chunk("side", "pdf")`}{Every plant by treatment group; the
caption stands beside the figure.\label{fig:side}}[R datasets: PlantGrowth.]

# Results

```{r full, fig.width = full[[1]], fig.height = full[[2]]}
plot_paper
```

\fullfigure{`r knitr::fig_chunk("full", "pdf")`}{The same figure across the text
block; the caption stands below it.}[R datasets: PlantGrowth.]
